observation_indicators.observable_fil: Naipapaliwanag sa residente ang layunin ng UHC at awtomatikong NHIP inclusion, at natutukoy ang benepisyo, provider, at hakbang na dapat tiyakin bago mangakong walang bayad.
observation_indicators.observable_en: Explains UHC's aim and automatic NHIP inclusion to a resident, and names the benefit, provider, and steps to check before promising no charge.
observation_indicators.not_yet_fil: Ipinapangakong libre ang lahat o hindi maipaliwanag ang dapat tiyakin.
observation_indicators.not_yet_en: Promises that everything is free or cannot explain what needs checking.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Naipapaliwanag ang dalawang punto at ang susunod na hakbang nang walang untag.
levels.kaya_na_en: Explains both points and the next step without prompting.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: Tama ang direksiyon ngunit kailangan ng gabay upang tukuyin ang dapat tiyakin.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Has the right direction but needs prompting to name what to check.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Hindi pa tumpak ang paliwanag o nangangako nang walang pagtitiyak.
levels.hindi_pa_en: The explanation is inaccurate or promises coverage without checking.
